subtitle: Time-based effects that create echoes and rhythmic patterns. From subtle slap-back to ambient washes, delay is one of the most versatile guitar effects.

introduction.title: What is Delay?
introduction.text: Delay creates echoes of your original signal by storing and playing back the audio after a specified time interval. The delayed signal can be repeated multiple times, creating rhythmic patterns, ambient textures, or simply adding space and dimension.

columns.title: Key Parameters
columns.text: Time: Delay length (milliseconds to seconds). Feedback: Number of repeats. Mix/Level: Wet/dry balance. Tone: EQ of delayed signal. Modulation: Pitch/time variations.

columns.title: Musical Applications
columns.text: Rhythmic echoes and patterns. Ambient soundscapes. Lead guitar enhancement. Creating space and depth. Doubling and thickening. Sound design and textures.

cards.title: Analog Delay
cards.description: Uses bucket brigade devices (BBDs) or tape to create warm, musical repeats that degrade naturally with each repeat.

fields.label: Characteristics
fields.value: Warm, musical degradation, limited delay time

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Boss DM-2, MXR Carbon Copy, Way Huge Aqua Puss

cards.title: Digital Delay
cards.description: Provides pristine, exact repeats with extensive control options and longer delay times.

fields.label: Characteristics
fields.value: Clean repeats, long delay times, precise control

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Boss DD-7, TC Electronic Flashback, Strymon Timeline

cards.title: Tape Echo
cards.description: Classic tape-based delays with natural modulation, compression, and warm, organic character.

fields.label: Characteristics
fields.value: Warm saturation, natural modulation, vintage vibe

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Echoplex EP-3, Space Echo RE-201, Belle Epoch

cards.title: Multi-Tap Delay
cards.description: Multiple delay taps create complex rhythmic patterns and intricate echo arrangements.

fields.label: Characteristics
fields.value: Multiple echoes, rhythm patterns, complex textures

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Empress Echosystem, Eventide TimeFactor, rack units

cards.title: Maestro Echoplex EP-3
cards.description: The gold standard of tape echo units. Warm, musical repeats with natural compression and saturation. Used on countless classic recordings.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Warm tape saturation, natural modulation, musical compression and EQ

cards.title: Roland Space Echo RE-201
cards.description: Iconic tape echo with spring reverb. Multiple playback heads create complex rhythmic patterns. Essential for dub, reggae, and ambient music.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Complex multi-tap patterns, warm tape character, integrated spring reverb

cards.title: Boss DM-2 Delay
cards.description: The first mass-market analog delay pedal. Warm bucket brigade delays with musical degradation. Compact and reliable.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Warm analog delays with natural high-frequency roll-off and musical repeats

cards.title: TC Electronic 2290
cards.description: Professional rack-mount digital delay with pristine sound quality and extensive modulation options. Studio standard in the 80s and 90s.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Crystal clear digital delays with precise timing and extensive modulation

sections.title: Delay Settings Guide
sections.warningText: Always set your delay time to musical subdivisions that complement the song. Use a tap tempo pedal or calculate delay times: 60,000 / BPM = quarter note delay time in milliseconds.
